title: Maintenance Tech Reports Suspicious Person Near Dock 1

lines.text: Control, this is Tech 7 from Maintenance. I’m at the gate near Dock 1 and saw a man in a grey hoodie walking toward the west-side junction. He didn’t have a badge and wasn’t on the manifest. I didn’t see him on camera, but I just stepped away from the monitor.
Copy, Tech 7. Confirm you did not see him on the CCTV feed from Gate 3 or the River Terminal Road zone?

Negative, Control. I was monitoring the west-side junction from OP-300-11, and he wasn’t on any of the live feeds. I just looked away for a second to check the valve status on TK-41, and when I came back, he was gone.

instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it down without engaging. The FSO will later confirm no one matches the description.
